learning_outcomes.text: The student can explain the seen topics regarding mobile communication theory. The student learns to search for equipment specifications on the internet and use them to solve real-life system exercises.

In three lab sessions, the student learns to measure fundamental parameters of communication systems and to handle various HF equipment. At the end of the semester, the student submits an individual report of these measurements, which may be carried out in a team of two students.
The student demonstrates the correct operation of their measurement setup using measurement results.
The student submits a report of the completed work at the end of the semester.

syllabus_topics: Lab 1 "," power measurements on various radio equipment
Lab 2 "," performance measurements on analog radio systems
Lab 3 "," designing, building (with software simulators) and measuring antennas
assessment_rules: For the first examination opportunity, the theory component (Mobile Communication: Theory) is assessed by a written exam (100%) including open questions, exercises, and multiple-choice questions with less strict penalty for guessing. The lab component (Mobile Communication: Lab) is assessed by assignments (100%). Successful partial results for YT5919 - Mobile Communication: Theory and YT5920 - Mobile Communication: Lab can be carried over within and across academic years. For the second examination opportunity, both theory and lab components are assessed by a written exam (100%) and written assignments (100%) respectively, similar to the first opportunity.
